issue.title: test_builtin_chop_handlers_satisfy_result_contract fails under the full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: While verifying an unrelated split of src/sase/monitor/resume.py into resume.py/resume_adoption.py/resume_delivery_state.py/resume_support.py, the mandatory just check gate's diff-scoped test lane escalated to the full 3828-file suite (stale coverage baseline) and failed exactly this node, twice in a row, with nothing else failing (1 failed, 1914 passed both times, under 4-worker xdist). The failure is an AssertionError that builtin chop 'sdk_registry_test' is not annotated to return ChopResultBuilder and does not delegate through runtime.hook_runner / runtime.check_cycle_runner. That chop name is only ever defined at tests/test_chop_sdk.py:292, which registers it into the shared _BUILTIN_CHOPS registry as part of its own test without evident cleanup; when that test's registration is still present in a worker process when test_axe_chop_output_contract.py's contract test runs, the contract test fails on the leaked entry. Isolated single-node runs of the contract test passed reliably (0.07s call) both on a clean master checkout and on the branch with the resume.py split present, confirming the split is unrelated. The fails-under-full-parallel-lane/passes-in-isolation shape matches the process-global-state-leak class owned by epic sase-j7 and the retired umbrella sase-ct (narrow node-specific records only, per its close reason).

task_type_fields.evidence: Reproduced twice in a row under just test-scoped (1 failed, 1914 passed in 141.14s; then 1 failed, 1914 passed in 136.14s), both times the sole failure among the escalated full-suite run under 4-worker xdist. Passed in isolation both times tried: on a clean git-stash of master (1 passed in 2.87s) and on the branch with the resume.py split present (1 passed in 2.72s). Fail rate: 2/2 full-parallel-lane runs fail this node; 0/2 isolated single-node runs fail. Root cause: tests/test_chop_sdk.py:292 registers a chop named 'sdk_registry_test' into the shared _BUILTIN_CHOPS registry without visible teardown/unregistration, so a worker process that already ran that test leaks the registration into test_builtin_chop_handlers_satisfy_result_contract's enumeration of every registered chop.

payload.entry: RELATED (recorded as a note because the artifact-link write lane is refusing writes — 'plans: hidden clone has uncommitted or untracked changes; preserving /home/bryan/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans'): sase-ct is the retired umbrella for full-parallel-lane flakes whose close reason directs narrow node-specific records like this one; epic sase-j7 owns the fails-under-parallel-lane/passes-in-isolation process-global-state-leak class this node's shape matches.

evidence.note: Reproduced again: while verifying an unrelated tests/pager/_rendered_link_corpus.py split, just check's diff-scoped lane escalated to the full suite (stale coverage baseline, 2354 items, 4 workers) and failed this same node (test_builtin_chop_handlers_satisfy_result_contract) with the same AssertionError about builtin chop 'sdk_registry_test'. Isolated rerun (pytest tests/test_axe_chop_output_contract.py::test_builtin_chop_handlers_satisfy_result_contract -x) passed in 2.70s on the same branch, confirming the split is unrelated and this is the same process-global-state-leak shape already documented on this bead.
